question: Simplify: frac{sqrt{5+2sqrt{6}}+sqrt{5-2sqrt{6}}}{sqrt{2}}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Express the terms inside the square root as perfect squares by finding factors of 6 that add up to 5 (which are 3 and 2).

5 + 2√6 = (√3 + √2)² and 5 − 2√6 = (√3 − √2)²

Numerator = √(√3 + √2)² + √(√3 − √2)² = (√3 + √2) + (√3 − √2) = 2√3

Given expression = 2√3 ÷ √2 = √2 × √3 = √6

**∴ The correct answer is √6.**
